description: This bar chart, titled "EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese Essay Writing," illustrates the sample count for two categories—"Open" (light blue) and "Cons." (pink)—across four essay genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, arranged along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," is scaled linearly from 0 to 120, with tick marks at intervals of 20, and the values for each bar are explicitly labeled on top. For the Argumentative genre, the "Open" category has a sample count of 79, while the "Cons." category has 122. In the Narrative genre, "Open" has 80 samples and "Cons." has 87. For the Descriptive genre, "Open" has 68 samples and "Cons." has 100. Finally, in the Expository genre, "Open" has 62 samples and "Cons." has 130. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each genre, with the "Open" bar appearing to the left of the "Cons." bar in each group. The chart does not indicate any sorting of the genres, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and numerical labels.
